escalate(bytes32).details: The v0 sketch here was exploitable (single-arbiter conclusion,      no quorum, anyone could add stake to anyone's dispute, ETH      stranded on upheld outcomes — review C3) and it is not on the      demo path. v1 fails loudly instead: no ETH can be escrowed, so      nothing can be stranded or stolen. The v2 design (3-of-N      staked auditors, majority rules, liars slashed) is sketched in      BULWARK_MASTER_PLAN.md Case 7.
